Abuja Design District

About ADD

Abuja Design District is a community where architects, interior designers, fashion houses, furniture makers, artists and galleries, craft producers and creative media come together to exhibit, collaborate, learn and do business.

Become a memberOur programmes
“ADD brings together fashion, architecture, interiors, art and product design to showcase Nigerian creativity, support collaboration and connect creative businesses with opportunities.”

Why ADD, why now

So much talent. Too few places to bring it together.

Nigeria has abundant creative talent, but few permanent platforms put architecture, interiors, fashion and object design in the same room.

What makes ADD different

Most design districts around the world are either property developments or neighbourhood associations. ADD is different: it connects northern and southern craft traditions, including adire and the Kano dye pits, Bida brass and glass, Aso Oke, leatherwork and woodcarving, with contemporary architects, interior designers and fashion houses.

That's a story no district abroad can tell. In everything we do, we show the maker alongside the designer.

A district without walls

Our programmes →
  1. Nov 2026 – Mar 2027 · Now

    1. Founding Network

    A curated group of founding members, the ADD brand, and a calendar of events hosted in member studios and partner venues.

  2. 2027

    2. Pilot District

    ADD becomes a recognised cluster: a shared map and signage, a regular Open Studios trail, a pop-up showroom and the first ADD Week.

  3. 2028 onward

    3. Anchor Hub

    A physical home for ADD, with a showroom, material library, co-working and event space.
